youtube.title: Your After-Hours Voicemail Only Says Closed (HVAC and Plumbing Business)
youtube.description:
An after-hours voicemail for an HVAC business that gives the caller a next step.
ServiceTitan looked at 2025 inbound calls to residential HVAC shops that use its software (participating customers, not nationally representative). In October, the lowest point of the year, 9.8% of calls arrived outside business hours: weekdays before 8 am or after 5 pm, plus weekends ("When Summer HVAC Demand Spikes, After-Hours Calls Do Too," ServiceTitan State of the Trades, June 3, 2026, read Nov 7, 2026).

The job for your office manager:
1. Change the after-hours message to: "You've reached [shop]. We're off until 7 am. Text this number your address and what's wrong, and we'll phone you first thing."
2. When a text comes in, call back first thing with the address and the problem in hand.

Send this to your office manager.
Next lesson: another owner problem from the trade forums, told start to finish.
